statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, (KdVPlan.MemH 0 f ↔ Memℓp f 2) ∧ ∀ h : Memℓp f 2, KdVPlan.hn 0 f = ‖(⟨f,h⟩ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖
proof:
intro f
have he : (fun k => KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖f k‖^2) = (fun k => ‖f k‖ ^ (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal) := by funext k; simp [KdVPlan.weight]
constructor
· simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, he] using (memℓp_gen_iff (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (by norm_num) (f := f)).symm
· intro h
  have he' : f = KdVPlan.FromLP 0 (⟨f,h⟩ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) := by funext k; simp [KdVPlan.FromLP, KdVPlan.weight]
  exact (congrArg (KdVPlan.hn 0) he').trans (h_T013.2.1 _ _)
